examples.scenario: Monthly digital marketing performance report for CMO

output.executive_summary: July delivered 187 MQLs — 7% below our 200 target, but organic search grew 11% MoM and is trending to hit target by September without paid support increases. Paid search performance was strong (CPA: $196 vs $230 target), but LinkedIn organic reach dropped 23% after a platform algorithm change in mid-July. Recommendation: pause the 3 underperforming LinkedIn ad sets and reallocate $2,400 to Google Search — our best-performing channel this month.

channel_narratives.organic_search: Organic delivered 93 MQLs at $0 marginal cost — our most efficient channel this month. The 11% session growth was driven by 3 blog posts published in May/June now ranking on page 1 for high-intent queries. 'Best CRM for agencies' moved from #8 to #3 this month — the single highest-traffic ranking change of the quarter. Watch: 2 articles from Q1 are declining; they need a content refresh before September or we lose those rankings.
channel_narratives.paid_search: Paid Search generated 94 MQLs at $196.80 CPA — well below our $230 target. The Brand campaign continues to outperform (CPA $62), but Non-Brand improved from $285 last month to $241 this month after the negative keyword expansion we ran June 28. The new PMAX campaign is still in learning phase — recommend not adjusting bids until August 14.
channel_narratives.email: Email performed above average this month. Open rate reached 31% — best in 8 months — driven by the subject line test we ran on the nurture sequence (winner: curiosity hook over benefit hook, +4.2pp open rate difference). Click rate of 4.8% is below our 6% target. Next test: CTA placement — currently bottom of email only.

recommendations.action: Pause 3 LinkedIn ad sets (IDs: LI-447, LI-449, LI-451) — all underperforming at CPA >$380, reallocate $2,400 to Google Search — Brand Exact and Top Non-Brand
recommendations.expected_impact: Est. +12-15 MQLs/month based on Google's current efficiency

recommendations.action: Refresh 2 declining organic articles ('SaaS pricing models' and 'product-led growth guide') — add 2026 data, expand FAQ sections, target 2,500 words
Run email CTA placement test — add CTA button at top of email (after paragraph 1) vs. current bottom-only placement
recommendations.expected_impact: If mid-email CTA wins by 1pp, adds est. 8-12 clicks/1000 emails

watchlist.item: PMAX campaign bid strategy auto-optimizing incorrectly — it's optimizing for form fills but our form has a pre-qualification bug. Fix form tracking BEFORE August 14 or PMAX will mislearn.

LinkedIn algorithm change in July reduced organic reach 23%. Competitors report same. Monitor August — if reach doesn't recover, shift LinkedIn budget to content amplification rather than paid campaigns.
Email open rate hit 31% — highest in 8 months. This sequence is warmer than usual. Consider moving bottom-funnel offers (demo request, trial) to email 4 in the nurture sequence (currently email 6).
